exposure: Cervical ripening and induction of labor with prostaglandin E1
cohort: 1713 women (523 primiparas, 656 multiparas, and 534 grand multiparas) who underwent cervical ripening and induction of labor with prostaglandin E1
finding: Using prostaglandin E1 for cervical ripening and labor induction is efficient and safe in primiparas, multiparas, and grand multiparas.
